Reuses shape_wedge’s arc_points()/validate_arc_args() helpers rather duplicating , mirroring curve_bezier/shape_bezier’s sharing. shape_blob – like shape_circle, radius perturbed [noise_field] (see ), giving irregular outline. range controls perturbation amplitude; noise (frequency, octaves, seed, ambient noise/fractal functions generate ) lives distortion property. shape_ribbon – tapered band (x, y) (xend, yend), width modulated distortion [noise_field] sqrt taper goes zero ends. shape_twist – like shape_ribbon, underlying path follows smoothed Brownian bridge (path_distortion [noise_bridge], reproducing e1071::rbridge()’s construction bit--bit seed without depending ) rather straight line. separate distortion [noise_field] property modulates width, exactly shape_ribbon – two independent distortion properties, one per noise class. shape_bezier – outline follows Bezier curve arbitrary number control points (x/y), evaluated via Bernstein polynomial basis (internal bernstein() helper, De Casteljau’s algorithm). Reuses shape_bezier/curve_bezier’s internal bezier_curve_points() helper (R/shape_bezier.R) compute backbone rather duplicating ; width still tapers zero ends varies along curve via distortion [noise_field], exactly shape_ribbon. curve_bezier – first curve_*()-prefixed drawable: open Bezier path, geometry = "path" fixed construction (exposed caller-facing argument). Shares path computation shape_twist via internal twisted_path_points() helper (R/shape_twist.R) rather duplicating – second real consumer motivated splitting noise_bridge class first place (see .agents/HISTORY.md). scale argument (rather shape_twist’s width) names underlying displacement-amplitude parameter, since ’s ribbon “width” describe. curve_line – open polyline arbitrary number (least two) control points (x, y), connected straight segments order. Unlike every drawable, points getter computation (xy(x = self@x, y = self@y) directly), ’s n argument. turns + n; angle sweeps 2 * pi * turns radians radius interpolates linearly radius_start radius_end, giving Archimedean-style spiral. Structurally closest shape_circle, needed file since angle range non-constant radius new. curve_scribble – single random wandering line (finite sum sine harmonics, unrelated curve_twist’s Brownian-bridge wandering), built internal scribble_lines() generator fill_scribble() already used tile texture (R/fill.R, shared rather duplicated), scaled arbitrary x/y + width/height bounding box sketch’s coordinate plane instead tiled inside fill pattern. direction ("horizontal"/ "vertical") controls axis along/across map , mirroring fill_scribble()’s direction argument. curve_raw – shape_raw’s "path"-geometry analog: x/y supplied directly points, connected straight segments smoothing/resampling/closing edge. Uses custom constructor (rather S7’s auto-generated one) purely canvas’s default can pre-built canvas() object rather embedded property default – see “Gotchas”. draw() – S7 generic, dispatch_args = "object". direction fixed "horizontal" "vertical" , arbitrary angle – see “Known limitation” docs section), fill_noise() (rasterised ambient simplex/fractal field, sampled torus seamless tiling), fill_marble()/fill_flow() (variants fill_noise() sharing internal torus_grid()/torus_noise() helpers: fill_marble() displaces sinusoidal bands torus-periodic turbulence veined look; fill_flow() domain-warps final field’s tile angles second, seed-decorrelated torus-periodic field swirlier, curl-noise-like look – share fill_noise()’s occasional faint tile-boundary rasterization seam, visible since sin()/warping amplify small mismatches), fill_image() (caller-supplied raster, letterboxed default preserve pixel aspect ratio), fill_gradient() (linear/radial via grid::linearGradient()/radialGradient()), fill_vignette() (colour faded via grid::.mask() alpha mask – helper using masks). fill_solid() return object grid::pattern(), sharing base S3 class "GridPattern". unifying design constraint across : grid::pattern() tiles sized fraction target polygon’s bounding box, fixed physical square, every helper takes aspect argument (target’s bounding-box width/height ratio) correct – computed via internal bbox_aspect() helper. Two different corrections needed depending ’s drawn: Directional content must tile seamlessly (fill_hatch()/ fill_crosshatch()) draws plain corner--corner diagonal controls rendered angle via tile’s width/height ratio (internal hatch_tile_dims() helper) – never via raw direction vector baked segment’s coordinates. extend = "repeat" translates tile copies whole tile-widths/heights, slope exactly 1 (corner--corner) leaves visible mismatch every tile edge. Content periodicity constraint (fill_stipple()’s dots, fill_gradient(), fill_vignette()’s mask) instead makes tile physically square (height = spacing * aspect), content drawn plain "npc" inside needs correction. Shared argument validation lives internal validate_fill_args() (spacing/aspect, optional angle check via angle = NULL).

title: A Minimal Drawing System For Generative Art
text: shape_blob() circle whose radius perturbed simplex noise. six blobs arranged around ring, one per colour:
code: library(sketchpad)  values <- tibble::tibble(   x = cos(seq(0, pi * 5 / 3, length.out = 6)),   y = sin(seq(0, pi * 5 / 3, length.out = 6)),   n = 500L,   fill = c("#e50000", "#ff8d00", "#ffee00", "#028121", "#004cff", "#770088"),   color = fill ) blobs <- purrr::pmap(values, shape_blob) blobs |> sketch() |> draw()

title: A Minimal Drawing System For Generative Art
text: Randomising position, radius, noise range many blobs gives organic composition:
code: set.seed(3) palette <- c("#e50000", "#ff8d00", "#ffee00", "#028121", "#004cff", "#770088") n_blobs <- 200L values <- tibble::tibble(   x = rnorm(n_blobs, sd = 1.5),   y = rnorm(n_blobs, sd = 1.5),   n = 500L,   fill = sample(palette, n_blobs, replace = TRUE),   radius = runif(n_blobs),   range = runif(n_blobs, min = 0, max = .5),   color = fill ) blobs <- purrr::pmap(values, shape_blob) blobs |> sketch() |> draw(xlim = c(-2, 2), ylim = c(-2, 2))

title: A Minimal Drawing System For Generative Art
text: shape_ribbon() tapered, noise-displaced band drawn two points:
code: set.seed(3) palette <- c("#e50000", "#ff8d00", "#ffee00", "#028121", "#004cff", "#770088") n_ribbons <- 200L values <- tibble::tibble(   x = rnorm(n_ribbons, sd = 1.5),   y = rnorm(n_ribbons, sd = 1.5),   xend = x + 1,   yend = y,   width = 1,   n = 500L,   fill = sample(palette, n_ribbons, replace = TRUE),   color = fill ) ribbons <- purrr::pmap(values, shape_ribbon) ribbons |> sketch() |> draw(xlim = c(-2, 2), ylim = c(-2, 2))

title: A Minimal Drawing System For Generative Art
text: shape_twist() like ribbon, follows Brownian bridge instead straight line, giving wandering, twisted appearance:
code: set.seed(1) palette <- c("#de9151", "#f34213", "#2e2e3a", "#bc5d2e", "#bbb8b2") n_twists <- 400L values <- tibble::tibble(   x = rnorm(n_twists, sd = 2),   y = rnorm(n_twists, sd = 2),   xend = x + 1,   yend = y + rnorm(n_twists, sd = 1),   width = runif(n_twists, min = .1, max = .3),   path_distortion = list(noise_bridge(smooth = 6L)),   n = 100L,   fill = sample(palette, n_twists, replace = TRUE),   color = fill ) twists <- purrr::pmap(values, shape_twist) twists |> sketch() |> draw(xlim = c(-2, 2), ylim = c(-2, 2))
